requirement.original: Fix check-budget-overage.py to support CNY and other currencies, not just EUR. The script at /root/travel-planner/scripts/check-budget-overage.py hardcodes EUR field names. It needs to detect the plan currency and use appropriate field names. For CNY plans, look for overage_cny or calculate overage from total vs user_budget fields in budget.json. NOTE: Bug8 and Bug26 are in the same file. Combine the fixes.
requirement.clarified: Fix check-budget-overage.py so it auto-detects currency from budget.json field names and uses the correct overage field (overage_eur or overage_cny or derived) for comparison. Rename EUR-hardcoded parameter threshold_eur to threshold_amount. Update all output labels to use the detected currency symbol. This is a combined Bug8 + Bug26 fix scoped to the single file.
requirement.what: Multi-currency support in check-budget-overage.py: detect currency, use correct field names, rename parameters, fix output labels
requirement.why: CNY-denominated plans (wangfujing-dongdan-beijing) fail with exit code 2 because the script only searches for overage_eur and overage_percentage, missing overage_cny and overage_percent. The output also incorrectly shows EUR symbols for non-EUR plans.

included: Currency detection logic (inspect field presence in data structure)
CNY overage field lookup: data.trip_summary.overage_cny, data.overage_cny, summary.overage_cny
CNY percentage field lookup: overage_percent (no 'age' suffix)
Per-day overage aggregation fallback from data.days[*].budget_vs_user.overage_cny
Rename function parameter threshold_eur to threshold_amount
Rename CLI argument label overage_threshold_eur to overage_threshold
Update all print() calls: replace hardcoded euro symbol with detected currency symbol
Update error message to list all searched field paths (EUR and CNY variants)
Update module docstring and usage examples
excluded: Currency conversion between CNY and EUR

success_criteria: EUR plan (overage_eur present) continues to produce correct output with euro symbol
CNY plan with data.trip_summary.overage_cny produces correct output with yen symbol
Plans with no recognizable overage field exit with code 2 and list all searched paths
No hardcoded overage_eur in field-lookup logic (only in currency detection map as a string key)
No hardcoded EUR symbol in output (symbol comes from detected currency)
Function signature uses threshold_amount not threshold_eur
constraints: Must not require changes to existing budget.json data files
Must handle both overage_percent and overage_percentage field name variants

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Running check-budget-overage.py against a CNY budget.json (e.g., wangfujing-dongdan-beijing) exits with code 2 and error: 'Missing overage_eur or overage_percentage'. The script never finds overage_cny or overage_percent.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Lines 53-66 of check-budget-overage.py search exclusively for 'overage_eur' (3 locations) and 'overage_percentage' (3 locations). CNY plans store overage as 'overage_cny' under 'data.trip_summary' and percentage as 'overage_percent' (without 'age' suffix). Neither variant is in the lookup. Additionally, the threshold parameter name 'threshold_eur' and all output labels embed 'EUR' / '€' unconditionally.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: cb6cc4d -- fix: deploy slug parsing bug + budget.json USD to CNY conversion
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The script was originally written for EUR-denominated European trips. When CNY support was added to the budget agent (commit cb6cc4d converted USD to CNY), new field names (overage_cny, overage_percent, trip_summary) were introduced in budget.json, but check-budget-overage.py was not updated to match.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Any CNY plan that runs through the generate-and-deploy pipeline will have its budget overage check silently fail with exit code 2, bypassing the threshold gate entirely. The reviewer gets no overage signal for CNY trips.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Script created before CNY support. CNY field names introduced in budget agent around commit cb6cc4d (2026-02-02 era). Script not updated at that time.

cny_plan_example.note: Also has per-day data.days[N].budget_vs_user.overage_cny as fallback

cny_multiday_no_summary.note: data is a list of day objects; must derive from per-day totals or treat as no-overage-data

development_approach.strategy: Replace the EUR-only field lookup with a currency-detection-then-lookup approach. Build a CURRENCY_FIELDS map keyed by currency code. Probe budget.json in priority order to identify currency. Then search for overage using the currency-specific field names. Fall back to per-day aggregation if trip_summary is absent. Rename threshold_eur parameter to threshold_amount throughout. Replace hardcoded euro symbol in all print() statements with the detected symbol.

currency_detection_order: Check for 'overage_eur' at root, data, summary → EUR
Check for 'overage_cny' at root, data, data.trip_summary, summary → CNY
Check for 'overage_amount' at root, summary → generic (no symbol prefix)
implementation_notes.per_day_aggregation: If no trip-level overage_cny found but data is a list, sum data[*].budget_vs_user.overage_cny or budget_vs_user.overage if present
implementation_notes.parameter_rename: threshold_eur → threshold_amount in function signature, default stays 200.0; update sys.argv[2] assignment comment and docstring
implementation_notes.output_label_fix: Replace all f-string '€{overage_eur' with f'{symbol}{overage_amount'; replace 'Thresholds: €{threshold_eur}' with f'Thresholds: {symbol}{threshold_amount}'

development_approach.validation_approach: QA should run the script against both EUR and CNY sample budget.json files and verify: exit codes, currency symbols in output, no stderr on valid files, and exit code 2 with descriptive message on missing-field files.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause: wrong field names in lookup dict and hardcoded currency symbol in output. No architectural decision or pattern choice involved.
